description: Source code for ApiClient class implementing a minimal REST client for notes CRUD operations, supporting both local API and JSONPlaceholder.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A minimal REST client for notes CRUD operations, supporting JSONPlaceholder and custom API endpoints.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes ApiClient with baseUrl and determines if using JSONPlaceholder.

methods.name: _url
methods.description: Constructs full URL for API requests based on path.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Performs fetch request with error handling and JSON parsing.

methods.name: _normalize
methods.description: Normalizes note object timestamps from snake_case to camelCase.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes from server, returning normalized array.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on server and returns normalized note.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note by id on server and returns normalized note.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by id on server, returns true on success.
